units.locator: Article 31.4. Enforcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 31.4. Enforcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 31.4

units.locator: Article 31.4. Enforcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.4. Enforcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 31.4

units.locator: Article 31.4. Enforcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. A ruling in an administrative offence case shall be enforced by the authorised body or official in accordance with the procedure established by this Code, other federal laws and resolutions of the Government of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with them.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 31.4

units.locator: Article 31.4. Enforcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. If several rulings imposing administrative penalties have been issued against one person, each ruling shall be enforced separately.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 31.4

units.locator: Article 31.4. Enforcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. If the method or procedure for enforcing a ruling in an administrative offence case is unclear, the body or official enforcing that ruling, as well as the person against whom it was issued, has the right to apply to the court, body or official that issued the ruling for clarification of the method and procedure for its enforcement.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 31.4

units.locator: Article 31.5. Deferral and instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: Article 31.5. Deferral and instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.label: Art. 31.5

units.locator: Article 31.5. Deferral and instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.5. Deferral and instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.label: Art. 31.5

units.locator: Article 31.5. Deferral and instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 1. Where circumstances make it impossible to enforce, within the established time limits, a ruling imposing administrative arrest, deprivation of a special right, forced expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation, or an administrative fine, the judge, body or official that issued the ruling may defer its enforcement for up to six months.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 31.5

units.locator: Article 31.5. Deferral and instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 2. Taking account of the financial situation of the person held administratively liable, the judge, body or official that issued the ruling may permit payment of the administrative fine in instalments over a period of up to three months.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 31.5

units.locator: Article 31.5. Deferral and instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 3. Deferral or instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine shall not apply to foreign citizens or stateless persons on whom an administrative fine has been imposed together with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation, or to persons on whom an administrative fine has been imposed for administrative offences specified in Articles 11.23, 11.26, 11.27, 11.29 or chapter 12 of this Code committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state, or in part 1 of Article 20.25 of this Code (insofar as it concerns failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence specified in Article 11.23, 11.26, 11.27 or 11.29 or chapter 12 of this Code committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state).
units.label: Part 3 Art. 31.5

units.locator: Article 31.5. Deferral and instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 4. When granting deferral or instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty, the court, body or official that issued it shall specify in the ruling the time from which enforcement of the administrative penalty begins.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 31.5

units.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.label: Art. 31.6

units.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.label: Art. 31.6

units.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 1. The judge, body or official that issued a ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall suspend its enforcement if a protest is lodged against the ruling in the administrative offence case that has entered into legal force, until the protest has been considered, and in other cases specified by this Code. A procedural order suspending enforcement of the ruling shall be issued and, where necessary, immediately sent to the body or official enforcing that procedural order.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 31.6

units.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 2. Lodging a protest against a ruling imposing administrative arrest, administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation in the form of forced expulsion from the Russian Federation, compulsory work or administrative suspension of activities shall not suspend enforcement of that ruling.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 31.6

units.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 3. The judge who issued a ruling imposing confiscation of the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence shall suspend its enforcement if the person specified in part 6 of Article 30.12 of this Code appeals against the ruling in the administrative offence case that has entered into legal force, until the appeal has been considered. A procedural order suspending enforcement of the ruling shall be issued and immediately sent to the body or official enforcing that procedural order.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 31.6

units.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 4. The judge, body or official that issued a ruling imposing an administrative penalty under an article (part of an article) of chapter 12 of this Code shall suspend its enforcement upon receipt of the procedural order requesting the administrative offence case materials specified in part 1 of Article 24.10 of this Code.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 31.6

units.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 5. The body whose official forwarded the record of the administrative offence specified in Article 12.24 of this Code and the materials attached to it specified in point 2 of part 1.7 of Article 28.8 of this Code shall suspend enforcement of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty specified in point 2 of part 1.7 of Article 28.8 of this Code.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 31.6

units.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 6. A procedural order suspending enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall be issued and, where necessary, sent immediately, but no later than one day after the day it is issued, to the body or official enforcing the ruling imposing the administrative penalty. A copy of that procedural order shall be sent to the person against whom the ruling imposing the administrative penalty was issued within one day after the day the procedural order is issued.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 31.6

units.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 7. A judge who has issued the ruling specified in point 5 of part 1 of Article 29.9 of this Code, a decision on an appeal (protest) against such a ruling leaving it unchanged and dismissing the appeal, or a ruling resulting from consideration of an appeal (protest) against those ruling and decision leaving them unchanged and dismissing the appeal against them, shall immediately resume enforcement of the unchanged ruling imposing a penalty in a case concerning an administrative offence specified in chapter 12 of this Code.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 31.6

units.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 8. A procedural order resuming enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall be issued. A copy shall be sent, no later than two days after the day it is issued, to the body or official enforcing the ruling imposing the administrative penalty and to the person against whom that ruling was issued.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 31.6

units.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.label: Art. 31.7

units.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.label: Art. 31.7

units.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: The judge, body or official that issued a ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall terminate its enforcement if:
units.label: Art. 31.7 · “The judge, body or official that issued a ruling imposing an…”

units.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 1) an amnesty act is issued that eliminates application of the administrative penalty;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 31.7

units.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 2) the law or provision establishing administrative liability for the act committed is repealed, except where provisions repealing administrative liability for the act and establishing criminal liability for the same act enter into force simultaneously;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 31.7

units.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 3) the person held administratively liable dies or is declared dead in accordance with the procedure established by law;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 31.7

units.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 3.1) an entry concerning liquidation of the legal entity held administratively liable is made in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities on the basis of an arbitrazh court’s procedural order completing liquidation proceedings in accordance with insolvency (bankruptcy) legislation;
units.label: Point 3.1 Art. 31.7

units.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 3.2) an entry concerning removal of the legal entity held administratively liable from the Unified State Register of Legal Entities is made in that register;
units.label: Point 3.2 Art. 31.7

units.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 4) the limitation periods for enforcement of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty established by Article 31.9 of this Code expire;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 31.7

units.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 5) the ruling is quashed;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 31.7

units.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 6) a ruling terminating enforcement of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty is issued in the cases specified by this Code;
units.label: Point 6 Art. 31.7

units.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 7) the circumstances specified in part 4 of Article 32.6.1 of this Code arise.
units.label: Point 7 Art. 31.7

units.locator: Article 31.8. Resolution of matters relating to enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: Article 31.8. Resolution of matters relating to enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.label: Art. 31.8

units.locator: Article 31.8. Resolution of matters relating to enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.8. Resolution of matters relating to enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.label: Art. 31.8

units.locator: Article 31.8. Resolution of matters relating to enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 1. Matters concerning clarification of the method and procedure of enforcement, deferral, instalment enforcement, suspension or termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty, restoration of the time limit specified in parts 1.3 - 1.3-3 of Article 32.2 of this Code, and recovery of an administrative fine imposed on a minor from the minor’s parents or other statutory representatives shall be considered by the judge, body or official that issued the ruling within three days of the ground for resolving the matter concerned arising.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 31.8

units.locator: Article 31.8. Resolution of matters relating to enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 2. Persons interested in the resolution of the matters specified in part 1 of this article shall be notified of the place and time of their consideration. Failure of interested persons to appear without a valid reason shall not prevent resolution of the matters concerned.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 31.8

units.locator: Article 31.8. Resolution of matters relating to enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 3. A decision on clarification of the method and procedure of enforcement, deferral, instalment enforcement or suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty, restoration of the time limit specified in parts 1.3 - 1.3-3 of Article 32.2 of this Code, and recovery of an administrative fine imposed on a minor from the minor’s parents or other statutory representatives shall be issued in the form of a procedural order. A copy of the procedural order shall be served against acknowledgement of receipt on the individual or the legal entity’s statutory representative in respect of whom it was issued, and on the victim. If those persons are absent, copies of the procedural order shall be sent to them within three days of its issue, and a corresponding entry shall be made in the case file.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 31.8

units.locator: Article 31.8. Resolution of matters relating to enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 4. A decision on termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall be issued in the form of a ruling.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 31.8

units.locator: Article 31.8. Resolution of matters relating to enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 5. A copy of a procedural order deferring, permitting instalment enforcement of or suspending enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine, and a copy of a ruling terminating enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine, shall be sent by the justice of the peace or commission on minors’ affairs and protection of their rights that issued it, within three days of issue, to the budget revenue administrator whose details must be included in the ruling imposing the administrative fine in accordance with part 1.1 of Article 29.10 of this Code, electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, or on paper where the technical means are unavailable.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 31.8

units.locator: Article 31.9. Limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: Article 31.9. Limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.label: Art. 31.9

units.locator: Article 31.9. Limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.9. Limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.label: Art. 31.9

units.locator: Article 31.9. Limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 1. A ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall not be enforced if it has not been enforced within two years of its entry into legal force.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 31.9

units.locator: Article 31.9. Limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 2. The limitation period specified in part 1 of this article shall be interrupted if the person held administratively liable evades enforcement of the ruling imposing the administrative penalty. In that event, calculation of the limitation period shall resume on the day that person is located or the person’s belongings or income against which administrative recovery may be directed under the ruling imposing the administrative penalty are discovered.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 31.9

units.locator: Article 31.9. Limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 3. Where enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty is deferred or suspended in accordance with Articles 31.5, 31.6 and 31.8 of this Code, the limitation period shall be suspended until expiry of the deferral or suspension period.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 31.9

units.locator: Article 31.9. Limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 4. Where instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty is permitted, the limitation period shall be extended by the instalment period.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 31.9

units.locator: Article 31.9. Limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 5. The limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty under an article (part of an article) of chapter 12 of this Code shall be suspended from the day the procedural order suspending enforcement of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty specified in part 4 or 5 of Article 31.6 of this Code is issued. The limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty under an article (part of an article) of chapter 12 of this Code shall resume if the procedural order resuming enforcement of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty specified in part 8 of Article 31.6 of this Code is issued.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 31.9

units.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.label: Art. 31.10

units.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.label: Art. 31.10

units.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 1. A ruling imposing an administrative penalty that has been enforced in full, bearing an endorsement that the administrative penalty has been executed, shall be returned by the body or official that enforced it to the judge, body or official that issued it.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 31.10

units.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 2. A ruling imposing an administrative penalty that has not been enforced or has been enforced only in part shall be returned by the body or official enforcing it to the judge, body or official that issued it if:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 31.10

units.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 1) the individual held administratively liable does not reside, work or study at the address specified by the judge, body or official that issued the ruling, the legal entity held administratively liable is not located there, or the property of those persons against which administrative recovery may be directed is not located there;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 31.10

units.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 2) the person held administratively liable has no property or income against which administrative recovery may be directed, and measures to locate that person’s property have been unsuccessful;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 31.10

units.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 3) the limitation period for enforcement of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty specified in Article 31.9 of this Code has expired;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 31.10

units.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 4) the circumstances specified in part 4 of Article 32.6.1 of this Code have arisen.
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 31.10

units.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 3. In the cases specified in points 1 and 2 of part 2 of this article, the official responsible for enforcement of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall draw up an appropriate statement, to be approved by a higher-ranking official.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 31.10

units.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 4. Return of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty on the grounds specified in points 1 and 2 of part 2 of this article shall not prevent that ruling being referred for enforcement again within the time limit specified in Article 31.9 of this Code.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 31.10

units.locator: Article 31.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty on a person residing or located outside the Russian Federation and having no property in the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 31.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty on a person residing or located outside the Russian Federation and having no property in the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 31.11

units.locator: Article 31.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty on a person residing or located outside the Russian Federation and having no property in the Russian Federation
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty on a person residing or located outside the Russian Federation and having no property in the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 31.11

units.locator: Article 31.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty on a person residing or located outside the Russian Federation and having no property in the Russian Federation
units.text: A ruling imposing an administrative penalty on a person residing or located outside the Russian Federation and having no property in the Russian Federation shall be enforced in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation and international treaties of the Russian Federation with the state in which that person resides or is located, and with the state in which the property of the person held administratively liable is located.
units.label: Art. 31.11 · text

units.locator: Article 31.12. Procedure for using documents produced electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, in the execution of administrative penalties
units.text: Article 31.12. Procedure for using documents produced electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, in the execution of administrative penalties

units.locator: Article 31.12. Procedure for using documents produced electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, in the execution of administrative penalties
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.12. Procedure for using documents produced electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, in the execution of administrative penalties
units.label: Art. 31.12

units.locator: Article 31.12. Procedure for using documents produced electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, in the execution of administrative penalties
units.text: Documents submitted to a body or official enforcing rulings imposing administrative penalties, or sent by such a body or official during execution of administrative penalties, may be produced electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, under the rules specified in Articles 24.8 and 24.9 of this Code.
units.label: Art. 31.12 · text
